ruleDefinitions.name: New Generic Credentials Added Via Cmdkey.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects usage of "cmdkey.exe" to add generic credentials.
As an example, this can be used before connecting to an RDP session via command line interface.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmdkey\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "cmdkey\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-g.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-p.*"))
